data.one_liner: Core data models, controllers, and utilities for the Flyer Chat ecosystem.
data.what_it_does: Provides the foundational building blocks such as message models, themes, and controllers required by flutter_chat_ui and related Flyer Chat packages. It manages chat data structures and configuration elements.
use_when: Building chat interfaces using the flutter_chat_ui package
Managing chat data models and controllers within the Flyer Chat ecosystem
avoid_when: Building standalone chat applications without flutter_chat_ui
Needing a general-purpose networking or backend-agnostic chat utility
strengths: Defines robust, standardized data models for chat applications
weaknesses: Not intended for standalone use outside of the Flyer Chat ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add both flutter_chat_core and flutter_chat_ui to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.
